item.title: Global Report Highlights Policy Gaps in Hepatitis Elimination Efforts
item.description: A global report shows uneven progress toward WHO hepatitis elimination goals, highlighting persistent policy and implementation gaps in testing and treatment. The post Global Report Highlights Policy Gaps in Hepatitis Elimination Efforts appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Hema Now: Behind the Scenes of EAHAD 2026
item.description: In this latest episode of Hema Now, we go behind the scenes of the EAHAD 2026 Congress, exploring how the programme is developed, key emerging priorities, and what lies ahead for haemophilia care in Europe. The post Hema Now: Behind the Scenes of EAHAD 2026 appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Does Bisoprolol Benefit Patients with COPD?
item.description: A major trial finds the beta blocker bisoprolol neither improves nor worsens outcomes in people with COPD, despite their high cardiovascular risk. The post Does Bisoprolol Benefit Patients with COPD? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: CT Biomarkers Linked to Oesophageal Cancer Survival
item.description: Sarcopenia, myosteatosis, and systemic immune inflammatory index were independently associated with reduced oesophageal cancer survival in patients treated with immunotherapy, supporting their role in prognostic assessment. The post CT Biomarkers Linked to Oesophageal Cancer Survival appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AstraZeneca bets big on China with $15bn investment
item.description: Pascal Soriot, CEO, AZ, hailed the investment as the start of "an exciting next chapter" for the company in China. The post AstraZeneca bets big on China with $15bn investment appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Optical Coherence Therapy Reveals Subclinical Benefits of Risankizumab in Psoriasis
item.description: A 52-week study shows risankizumab improves both visible psoriasis and underlying vascular inflammation, with OCT revealing sustained subclinical skin changes. The post Optical Coherence Therapy Reveals Subclinical Benefits of Risankizumab in Psoriasis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Early-Life Sugar Rationing Reduced Heart Failure Risk
item.description: Those exposed to early-life sugar rationing had an approximately 14% lower risk of developing heart failure and were diagnosed an average of 2.6 years later than individuals who were unexposed. The post Early-Life Sugar Rationing Reduced Heart Failure Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.
